opportunities.name: TechCrunch Startup Battlefield 200
opportunities.desc: 200 standout startups pitch at TechCrunch Disrupt. 5 finalists compete for the $100K equity-free prize and the Disrupt Cup. Massive investor and media visibility, pitch training & VC masterclasses included. Any industry.

opportunities.name: Women Founders Network Fast Pitch
opportunities.desc: 14th annual competition for US women-owned businesses. Winners in Tech and CPG categories each receive $25,000. Must have raised under $750K. No equity.

opportunities.name: Cartier Women's Initiative 2027
opportunities.desc: One of the world's most prestigious women entrepreneur grants. 1st: $100K, 2nd: $60K, 3rd: $30K. Any sector. Must be impact-driven, with recurring revenue. Includes INSEAD fellowship.

opportunities.name: ED/IES SBIR — Phase IB (EdTech MVP)
opportunities.desc: Dept. of Education SBIR for startups with existing EdTech prototypes. Phase IB specifically strengthens research-based MVPs. Phase I: $250K → Phase II: $1M. Must register on SAM.gov first. Zero equity.

opportunities.name: AI for Good Innovation Factory Grand Finale
opportunities.desc: UN-backed ITU competition for AI startups solving real-world problems. $20K cash to top startup. Global summit in Geneva, July 7–10.

opportunities.name: Entrepreneurship World Cup 2026
opportunities.desc: One of the world's largest startup competitions — any industry, any stage. $1M equity-free across Idea, Early, and Growth tracks + dedicated AI track. Top 250 get mentorship & pitch training.

opportunities.name: EdTech Week — Shark Tank NYC
opportunities.desc: Purpose-built for early-stage EdTech with MVP. Panel of top EdTech investors pledge up to $250K collectively. Applications reviewed through Sep 2 for Oct 20–22 event.

opportunities.name: Startup World Cup — NYC Regional
opportunities.desc: Global competition open to any domain, any stage. NYC regional winner advances to Grand Finals in San Francisco. Grand prize: $1M investment.

opportunities.name: Queens Tech & Innovation Challenge
opportunities.desc: Five grants of up to $20K each with zero strings attached. Early-stage entrepreneurs. Includes mentorship, office hours, networking events.

opportunities.name: NYCEDC Founder Fellowship 2026
opportunities.desc: NYC Economic Development Corp fellowship for diverse tech founders. Network, mentorship, fundraising access. ~$1M in capital commitments across cohort.

opportunities.name: Entrepreneurs Roundtable Accelerator (ERA) NYC
opportunities.desc: Top NYC accelerator explicitly accepting EdTech. Offers seed capital, mentorship, workspace, and VC introductions. Rolling applications.

opportunities.name: New York Business Plan Competition (NYBPC)
opportunities.desc: One of NYC's longest-running cross-industry startup competitions. Open to all sectors. Judged by real investors. Strong alumni network.

opportunities.name: Chloe Capital NYC Founder Fellowship
opportunities.desc: Women founders fellowship. Hybrid format — mostly virtual, few in-person NYC days. Min. $300K invested across ≥3 companies. At least one founder must live in NYC's 5 boroughs.

opportunities.name: Milken–Penn GSE Education Business Plan Competition
opportunities.desc: Most prestigious education startup competition globally. $2M+ awarded historically. Semifinalists join Catapult virtual accelerator at Penn GSE. Finals in NYC.

opportunities.name: Learning Engineering Tools Competition
opportunities.desc: Over $3M total prize pool. Catalyst ($50K) for early-stage, Growth ($150K) for MVPs with users, Transform ($300K) for platforms at scale.

opportunities.name: SXSW EDU Launch Startup Competition
opportunities.desc: Presented by Walton Family Foundation. Early-stage EdTech founders pitch live on stage at SXSW EDU 2027 in Austin. Three awards: Launch, Impact, and Community Choice.

opportunities.name: Global EdTech Startup Awards (GESAwards)
opportunities.desc: World's largest EdTech competition — 6,000+ startups from 130 countries. Regional semifinals virtual. Finals at Bett Global in London.

opportunities.name: LearnLaunch Breakthrough to Scale
opportunities.desc: The leading EdTech-only accelerator in the US. $50K initial investment + up to $150K milestone-based follow-on. Backed 91 companies raising $300M+.

opportunities.name: Michigan Virtual EdTech Catalyst
opportunities.desc: Annual EdTech pitch contest with bootcamp. 1st place: $10K startup grant + marketing & legal support.

opportunities.name: FETC Pitchfest — Future of Education Technology
opportunities.desc: K–12 focused gamified pitch competition. Audience votes live at FETC in Orlando. Must have raised under $8M.

opportunities.name: RAISE the STAKES — World's Largest AI Startup Competition
opportunities.desc: Over €10M in prizes for pre-seed, seed, and Series A AI companies. Largest AI-specific prize pool globally.

opportunities.name: NSF SBIR — Learning & Cognition Technologies
opportunities.desc: NSF's SBIR with dedicated Learning and Cognition Technologies track. AI in education, training tools, innovative content delivery. Phase I: up to $305K → Phase II: $2M. Zero equity.

opportunities.name: Google for Startups Accelerator — AI First
opportunities.desc: 10-week accelerator for AI-first US/Canada startups. Up to $350K in Google Cloud credits. Technical training, 1:1 Google engineers, product design workshops. Zero equity.

opportunities.name: Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub
opportunities.desc: Open enrollment — no pitch required. Up to $150K in Azure credits, GitHub Enterprise, OpenAI credits, and technical mentoring.

opportunities.name: AWS Education Accelerator
opportunities.desc: Hybrid EdTech accelerator. Up to $100K in AWS computing credits, zero equity. Business and technical guidance, go-to-market strategy.

opportunities.name: Google Cloud Startup Program
opportunities.desc: Open to any tech startup building on Google Cloud. Apply independently for up to $200K in immediate Google Cloud credits.

opportunities.name: Google for Startups Black Founders Fund — US
opportunities.desc: Cash grants and hands-on technical support specifically for Black-led US startups. No equity exchange.

opportunities.name: NAACP Powershift Entrepreneur Grant
opportunities.desc: For Black entrepreneurs and businesses. $25,000 grant plus additional resources. Backed by L'Oréal.

opportunities.name: Black Girl Ventures Foundation
opportunities.desc: Crowdfunded pitch competition for Black and Brown women founders. Community votes determine funding. $5K–$10K per winner.

opportunities.name: Amber Grant for Women
opportunities.desc: The most accessible women's grant — $10K awarded every single month to a woman-owned business. Annual winner also receives an additional $25K grant.

opportunities.name: Siakam EdTech Engine Accelerator
opportunities.desc: For early-stage EdTech startups — K–12, youth learning, AI-driven skill development across North America. Top-performing teams receive from a $50K grant pool.

opportunities.name: EdTech Breakthrough Awards
opportunities.desc: Annual awards recognizing best EdTech products across categories. Free to enter. Winning or finalist status generates real investor and customer credibility.
